scope: existing-container CPU closed meshes, no AppLauncher or PhysX; no GPU
command:
import json, torch
from stair_terrain import build_stair_generator, stair_meshes
results=[]
for direction in ('asc','desc'):
 spec={'height':.17,'depth':.25,'num_steps':100,'width':1.2,'direction':direction}
 cfg=build_stair_generator(spec=spec,num_rows=1,num_cols=1,seed=1)
 term=cfg.sub_terrains['heldout'];meshes,origin=stair_meshes(.5,term.replace(size=cfg.size));meta=meshes[0].metadata['stair_geometry']
 assert cfg.size==(30.,3.) and len(meta['treads'])==100
 assert all(m.is_watertight and m.is_winding_consistent for m in meshes)
 assert meta['start_x']==0 and abs(meta['goal_x']-26.65)<1e-9 and meta['goal_dwell_s']==.5
 assert abs(float(origin[2])-(0. if direction=='asc' else 17.))<1e-9
 assert abs(meta['goal_platform_z']-(17. if direction=='asc' else -17.))<1e-9
 assert abs(float(origin[2])+meta['goal_platform_z']-(17. if direction=='asc' else 0.))<1e-9
 results.append({'direction':direction,'terrain_size':cfg.size,'mesh_count':len(meshes),'all_meshes_closed_and_winding_consistent':True,'origin_world_z_m':float(origin[2]),'goal_platform_z_relative_to_origin_m':meta['goal_platform_z'],'terminal_platform_world_z_m':float(origin[2])+meta['goal_platform_z'],'goal_x_relative_m':meta['goal_x'],'num_steps':meta['num_steps'],'goal_dwell_s':meta['goal_dwell_s']})
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print(json.dumps({'status':'CPU_GEOMETRY_PASS_NO_SIMULATION','cuda_initialized':torch.cuda.is_initialized(),'cases':results}))
